Every parameter sent header every call. ... Named parameters appended url, token = "...". user_id, session_id, user_agent user id sent every call (default user_id parameter, SPARK_USER, USER), session's id (UUID; default new version 4 UUID), text starts client type server logs (default SPARK_CONNECT_USER_AGENT, "zuspark"). takes precedence parameter name url. headers Extra headers every call, named character vector, names valid URL. deadline Seconds call query may take. default 30. con zuspark_connection. allow_reconnect TRUE, server lets later connection reuse session's id. default id retired session.
